versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g Definition of required resource in the context of the Software Cluster Binary Manifest A required resource of a Software Cluster Binary Manifest represents an request of the Software Cluster towards other Software Cluster s. For the formal point of view, this request is defined by means of a BinaryMani- festRequireResource , aggregated at CpSoftwareClusterBinaryManifest- Descriptor in the role requireResource . Required resources could be left unconnected unless attribute connectionIs- Mandatory is set to True .
